events.text: Hechler was transferred back to the Kriegsmarine at his own request.

events.quote: On 1 July 1943 Hechler was transferred back to the Kriegsmarine at his own request

events.text: Hechler attained the rank of Korvettenkapitän.

events.quote: attaining the rank of Korvettenkapitän on 3 July

events.text: Hechler underwent a number of training courses for submarine commanders.

events.text: Hechler was stationed in Bremen for construction training.

events.quote: Hechler was stationed in Bremen from 3 January to 2 February 1944 for construction training

events.text: Ernst Hechler died aged 57 in Alzey, Federal Republic of Germany.

events.quote: Ernst Hechler died on 23 October 1965 aged 57 in Alzey , Federal Republic of Germany
